standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion that a flat finitely presented groupoid with open-immersion relation has an etale quotient
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 7341-7352)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives etaleness of the quotient morphism.

core_obligations: Set up the groupoid: from the quasi-splitting of the vector bundle form the groupoid whose relation is given by the stabilizer, and identify the quotient of the groupoid with the required quotient (proof lines 7314-7330)
Openness of the relation: the relation of that groupoid is an open immersion by the construction of the quasi-splitting (proof lines 7331-7343)
Apply the criterion: the quotient is flat and locally of finite presentation over the base by construction, so the flat groupoid criterion makes the quotient morphism etale (proof lines 7344-7354)
proof_roadmap: 由稳定向量丛的 quasi-splitting 造出群胚 (U, R)：R 是稳定子给出的子空间。
由构造 R → U × U 是开浸入。
对平坦有限表现群胚用「关系为开浸入 ⇒ 商 étale」的判据，得商到基的 étale。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a quasi-splitting of a stable vector bundle over a base yields an etale morphism from the associated quotient (author lemma at source lines 7299-7312, label lemma-quasi-splitting-etale). The proof (source lines 7314-7355) forms the groupoid determined by the quasi-splitting, verifies that its relation is an open immersion and applies the flat groupoid criterion for etaleness of a quotient (proof lines 7314-7354). The construction of the groupoid and the verification of openness are the substance. H3.
